notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the 1.1.0 ![/b]

Here is the changes you'll find in this update:

[u]UI:[/u]

    - New Options button for Steam edition that open the "escape" menu
    - Click on the game version will now show the patchnote

[u]GAMEPLAY:[/u]

    - New superpower for the sheriff
    - New superpower for the outlaw

[u]FIXS:[/u]

    - Using the resurrection power as the outlaw if the Sheriff is using the gatling will effectively trigger at the first hit
    - Code reorganization to make rooms more flexibles (for next features)
    - Collision issue in Saloon map
    - No more black screen for host if the opponent disconnect while loading
    - Improve collision of a tree on Volcano
    - Fix wrong apparition of superpowers if opponent change during a game

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]UI:[/b]

[list]
    [*] The game can now show patchnotes. Like this one! Yey
    [*] Delete black pixel on main menu screen background
    [*] Add more visuals about the "ready" status of player in waiting room
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]

[list]
    [*] Birds will alert less often (2.5 secondes -> 5 secondes)
[/list]

[b]FIXS:[/b]

[list]
    [*] Outlaw's knife should correctly kill people (fix some collision bugs)
    [*] Remove antialiasing warning on Sheriff shoots
    [*] Point computation when changing opponent
[/list]
